title: Nidoran♂ Has Ears That Point Anywhere

direction.premise: Nidoran♂'s ear muscles let it aim both ears in any direction, making even tiny sounds hard to miss.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Nidoran♂ turns movable ears into an always-alert defense, then discover why hearing danger is not enough.
direction.openLoop: If its ears catch everything, can anything still surprise Nidoran♂?
direction.payoff: Its ears move in every direction to detect danger, then it attacks with poison.
direction.engagementQuestion: Better defense: movable ears or a poisonous horn?

voice.instructions: Use a curious, alert tone. Speak briskly with clean pauses after each short idea. Stress direction words and the final choice.

scenes.headline: EARS THAT POINT ANYWHERE
scenes.narration: Nidoran♂ can point both ears in any direction.
scenes.caption: NOT JUST UP

scenes.headline: MUSCLES CONTROL EACH EAR
scenes.narration: Special ear muscles let it move each ear freely, all around.
scenes.caption: BUILT TO AIM

scenes.headline: EVEN TINY SOUNDS REGISTER
scenes.narration: Even the slightest sound can still reach its attention.
scenes.caption: NOTHING SOUNDS SMALL

scenes.headline: THE EARS KEEP SCANNING
scenes.narration: It keeps scanning, raising those ears above the grass for danger.
scenes.caption: EVERY DIRECTION GETS CHECKED

scenes.headline: HEARING DANGER IS NOT SAFETY
scenes.narration: But sensing danger is not safety. It strikes with poison.
scenes.caption: THE RESPONSE STILL MATTERS

scenes.headline: WHICH DEFENSE WINS?
scenes.narration: Better defense: movable ears or a poisonous horn?
scenes.caption: HEAR FIRST OR STRIKE FIRST?
